name: guard-initcode-not-metered-at-merge
rationale: EIP-3860 regression guard. The per-word initcode charge (2 gas per 32-byte word) must NOT apply at Merge, so 53016 gas is exactly enough for tx 0 and it is included. At Shanghai the same tx needs 53018 and joins tx 1 in `rejected`. The Merge variant also asserts that `currentDifficulty` is a key of the result document from the Merge onward.
source: synthetic (step 04 reviser, round 1) -- regression guard for a Shanghai behaviour that instruction.md forbids leaking backwards
